installCommand: mkdir -p bin && curl -sSL https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/download/v0.145.0/hugo_extended_0.145.0_linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C bin hugo
buildCommand: BASE="${DEV_BASE_URL:-$VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL}"; if [ -z "$BASE" ]; then echo 'ERROR: DEV_BASE_URL is empty. Set it in Vercel > Settings > Environment Variables to the deployment host, with no protocol and no trailing slash (e.g. my-project.vercel.app). Building without it produces a site with no CSS or JS, because canonifyURLs makes every asset URL absolute and the CSP only allows self.'; exit 1; fi; ./bin/hugo --gc --minify -D -e staging --baseURL "https://$BASE/"
